brief:
A humanitarian official told Al Jazeera English that Israeli tactics are creating conditions making life "untenable" for millions of Palestinians. Athena Rayburn discussed how the situation has deteriorated even as the Board of Peace has reported progress on various initiatives. The official's assessment highlights a widening gap between the humanitarian realities facing Palestinians and the work being promoted by the peace organization.

Rayburn pointed to specific Israeli practices as drivers of the worsening conditions affecting Palestinians across multiple sectors. She detailed how these tactics compound existing challenges and limit access to basic services and resources. The humanitarian's comments underscore tensions between diplomatic efforts and on-the-ground conditions that Palestinians confront daily.
dek: Humanitarian official Athena Rayburn dissects the Israeli tactics making life ‘untenable’ for millions of Palestinians.
title: Humanitarian official warns Israeli tactics make Palestinian life untenable
